source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Hardware Status" -> "Sensors"
Compare each sensor's reading and setting with BMC sensor spec.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'TEMP_AMBIENT' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES can provide one sensor read only if the literal name is valid, but its truncated fallback contradicts `FULL` and it supplies no physical sensor location, reference ambient measurement, accuracy/tolerance, update delay, complete threshold mask or WebUI/spec comparison. It also fixes cipher 17 and exposes the password.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly adds a calibrated reference and location-aware comparison. V3.1 further distinguishes rack inlet, room ambient and internal board-adjacent air; defines co-location/time-stability rules so a valid spatial gradient is not called a sensor error; and gates the common internal Script on a pinned reviewed revision.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 870/2291 accepts a single `sensor get` output as agent-direct and never establishes where TEMP_AMBIENT is located, what ambient reference/tolerance applies, whether the UI is fresh or which thresholds must be present.

historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the source and generic clear text; ED-34 treats sensor location/reference/spec/Script as readiness; ED-35 preserves this read-only observation without inventing environmental stimulus; ED-38 requires protected evidence, no clear/write/retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that the exact `TEMP_AMBIENT` environmental sensor is correctly identified and human-readable in Hardware Status > Sensors and that its reading, units, health state and supported thresholds agree with the platform specification and a properly located time-aligned ambient reference within the approved tolerance.
original_method: Read the complete `TEMP_AMBIENT` SDR/API object, capture the same object in the WebUI and compare both with a calibrated ambient reference placed at the specification-defined location under a stable condition. Existing logs are preserved and neither the environment nor thresholds are changed.
manual_activity: A thermal/platform owner identifies the physical TEMP_AMBIENT sensor and specifies whether it represents rack inlet, chassis inlet, room or another local air point. An operator places/records the calibrated reference probe without disturbing airflow. Automation performs synchronized read-only collection and comparison; the engineer owns tolerance interpretation and verdict.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/chassis/firmware/WebUI/SDR identity and stable sensor number/type/entity/instance mapped to the UI row
Documented sensor physical location and intended measurand plus reference-probe placement, distance/orientation, airflow and shielding constraints
Expected Celsius range, scaling/rounding, calibration accuracy, allowed combined uncertainty/tolerance, update period and stabilization window
Supported lower/upper threshold capability mask, values, hysteresis, status and not-applicable/unavailable handling
Calibrated reference thermometer identity, certificate/current calibration, accuracy/resolution and synchronized timestamp record
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions and protected authentication; pinned readable Script revision/checksum or approved manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or system logs. Deletion is unrelated to the sensor reading and removes thermal/health context.

Do not infer that room temperature equals this sensor's local air temperature. Use the specified measurement point; record airflow, load and rack/chassis state so expected gradients are not misclassified.
Do not heat, cool, block airflow, alter fan controls or change thresholds for this read-only case. Any environmental sweep or threshold transition requires a separately approved thermal test.
Do not select a sensor by label alone when duplicate/aliased instances exist. Bind UI and OOB evidence using stable SDR identity and physical-location mapping.
Do not use `head -100` or call partial/empty output full. Capture the exact complete object, threshold capability and status with timestamps and error status.

Do not expose credentials with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the unavailable Script until its immutable content is reviewed. Stop without automatic retry on identity, unit, calibration, reference-location or freshness ambiguity.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/client, exact sensor/physical mapping, reference-instrument status and approved placement before collecting data; review the pinned Script if selected.
After the operator records a stable reference condition, capture synchronized complete raw sensor/threshold/status data and the unchanged Hardware Status > Sensors representation.
Apply only approved scaling, rounding, update-delay and combined-tolerance rules; compare sensor, UI and reference with uncertainty and timestamp details rather than simple string equality.
Re-read once only if required by the defined stability window, not as retry after failure; preserve evidence and never clear, modify environment/thresholds or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the sensor/location mapping, intended ambient measurand and reference-probe placement under the selected platform/rack condition.
Provide expected values, accuracy/tolerance, scaling, stabilization/update timing and threshold capability/status rules; approve the Script/tool.
Interpret legitimate spatial/time gradients, review field-level evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a tentative raw read after exact identity and safe transport are validated. It cannot prove physical ambient accuracy, reference agreement or WebUI rendering; the fallback is truncated and the authentication assumptions are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect the complete exact TEMP_AMBIENT SDR/API record through protected access and the matching WebUI fields at a stable timestamp, while an approved calibrated probe measures the specification-defined ambient point; compare using the declared scaling, lag and uncertainty tolerance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_AMBIENT, Hardware Status > Sensors, reading/setting comparison, readability/spec Criteria, source clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; no active thermal stimulus is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a synchronized three-way comparison among canonical sensor data, WebUI rendering and a calibrated co-located ambient reference, with declared airflow/load/stability and uncertainty controls.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/BMC/SDR build and rack condition for which TEMP_AMBIENT location and accuracy are documented.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, SDR package, WebUI build, client, reference-instrument calibration and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform thermal sensor map/specification, WebUI field definitions, Project environmental acceptance limits and reference-instrument calibration record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical measurand/location, independent reference, uncertainty and time alignment while protecting existing evidence and avoiding an unrequested thermal manipulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable current value does not prove threshold transitions, calibration across range, response time under changing environment or protective thermal behavior; those remain separate tests.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sensor/location map, expected range/thresholds/tolerance, calibrated reference/stability, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Rack gradients, recirculation, probe placement and UI caching can create real differences; an incorrect mapping can silently validate another temperature sensor.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use an approved Redfish/OEM sensor interface instead of ipmitool when it records the preserved method, actual interface/version, reason, engineer approval, field-level equivalence and any unverified ipmitool/UI coverage. It may define a different reference point only with documented thermal equivalence and uncertainty; no override may claim active threshold coverage from this snapshot.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/chassis, firmware/WebUI/SDR identities and stable TEMP_AMBIENT sensor/UI/physical-location map
Complete raw sensor record with reading, Celsius units/scaling, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, status and synchronized timestamp
Redacted Hardware Status > Sensors evidence tied to the same identity and refresh/update interval
Reference probe identity/calibration/accuracy, placement photo or diagram, airflow/load/rack condition, stable readings and timestamps
Approved tolerance/uncertainty/rounding/lag calculation and field-level sensor-versus-UI-versus-reference comparison
Pinned Script review or approved alternate method, no-clear/no-write/no-stimulus/no-retry proof, BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Sensor Page procedure and Criteria consistently define a read-only ambient sensor/spec check. The missing physical location, reference and tolerance are normal Project/vendor readiness inputs, not conflicting core semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sensor, UI location and read/spec purpose are identifiable. Location, calibrated reference, expected values and Script/tool details can be supplied, so this is PACKAGE rather than permanent BLOCKED; execution waits for those inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible Celsius number from passing when it measures the wrong physical air point, is stale or lacks threshold/status context, while avoiding unsafe environmental manipulation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ambient is a physical measurand tied to location and airflow, not merely a label. A BMC value can legitimately differ from room temperature because of inlet gradients, recirculation and sensor lag. Correctness therefore requires a documented sensor location and a co-located time-aligned reference with combined uncertainty, alongside the raw/UI field match; a single ipmitool number cannot provide that chain.
